assertions: The shared footer model preserves the actionable error copy and adds Retry only when a retry intent exists.
The shared footer model changes Retry to a disabled Retrying state while recovery is active.
Web ProjectPicker surfaces directory errors and resets the request before retrying.
Lynx LandingComposer surfaces filesystem errors through the same shared composition and wires refetch to Retry.
Both platform element adapters render the shared error and retry anatomy; neither owns a separate ordinary error model.
